claude_proposed_widenings.name: Attachment.kind = "item" | "object" on activation phases
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Tree Form targets the staff itself, not the wielder, a creature, or an area.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: plant one end of the staff in earth in an unoccupied space and expend 1 charge to transform the staff into a healthy tree

claude_proposed_widenings.name: EffectAtom.kind = "fall_on_end" (or equivalent end-of-form fallout rider)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Reverting the transformed staff has a deterministic mechanical consequence for creatures occupying it. v4 already has this concept, but the surface does not.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Any creature in the tree falls when the tree reverts to a staff

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ItemDestructionPolicy nondestructive last-charge shutdown
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The last-charge rider removes the item's magic without destroying the underlying quarterstaff, which current destruction policies cannot represent honestly.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If you expend the last charge, roll 1d20. On a 1, the staff loses its properties and becomes a nonmagical Quarterstaff

discrepancies: tracer emitted atom 'item_destruction' not in claude's claim
